name: TikTok Ads Audiences
shortInfo: Sync data from your data warehouse to TikTok custom audiences.
brief: Move custom data from your data warehouse to create selected audiences in TikTok Ads.
about:
Advertise on TikTok. Make ads that entertain and campaigns that connect. Where large and small businesses, agencies & creators can achieve big results.  
  
Learn more about [TikTok Ads.](https://www.tiktok.com/en/)
availableSync:
[Audience Upload](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/tiktok/syncs/audience-upload.html)

This sync can be used to upload audience data from a user specified datawarehouse to the TikTok platform.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/tiktok/index.html) here.
